== frame basic cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a$(echo b)c `echo d`e
|abc de
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

== frame nested cursor=6,20

== frame word_splitting cursor=9,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a$(echo b)c `echo d`e
|abc de

|nested

|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo "$(echo   spaced   out)" $(echo   spaced   out)
|spaced out spaced out
|
